A. The terrifying reality of Medieval life during the Norman invasion best captures the video's broad focus on William, the Normans, and the brutal conquest of England, rather than any single battle (B, C) or solely the Anglo-Saxon perspective (D).

C. The Battle of Stamford Bridge was on 25 September 1066, after which the Norman armada set sail (~September 27) and landed near Pevensey/Hastings, whereas Harold's coronation, William's marriage, and Edward's death all occurred earlier.
